I attended the practice to enquire about the process of appointment on Monday to be told the practice manager would call me back.
To call again today and be told I had missed an appointment for said ailment - which was incorrect, it was actually a cancelled vaccination appointment.
Then to be told I hadn’t sent images across,  when I in fact have, not once but twice. To it now transpiring that it’s in with the GP and that’s alls they can say. Which is convenient as I’d gone from missing an appointment(which never was for the issue), to myself ‘not sending across images in time’, to then it now being with the doctor.
When you can get in to see a GP they’re great,
Unsure if this is a PATCHS or receptionist/admin training issue but it’s not great practice and long gone are the days someone, namely a receptionist can just have a transparent conversation and tell me it hasn’t been picked up.
